topic: How are link budgets affected when prioritizing high-revenue services versus navigation safety margins in dynamic scheduling?
consensus_response: Prioritizing high-revenue services increases link budgets, leading to potential signal degradation and interference. Mitigation strategies include diversity techniques (e.g., beamforming, spatial multiplexing), spacing optimization, proportional fairness, load balancing, and feedback mechanisms. These strategies aim to balance revenue maximization with safety margins, ensuring QoS guarantees are not violated. DLB focuses on the physical layer and its impact on link budgets, while PNM analyzes the impact of dynamic scheduling on link budgets and QoS.  Both perspectives highlight the need for a balanced approach to prioritize services and maintain network performance.
